facts.business: Dish TV India Limited provides direct-to-home (DTH) satellite TV broadcasting services and has diversified into smart TVs (VZY brand), OTT content aggregation (Watcho app), B2B e-commerce (ShopZop platform), and content trade hub (Content India).

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern (Note 4(b)) - conditions exist that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern, but financial statements prepared on going concern basis; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and negative net worth
Impairment of investments and loans in subsidiaries (Rs 59,209 lacs impairment recognized in FY26)
Regulatory and tax contingencies with significant contingent liabilities
Declining subscription revenue and ARPUs in core DTH business (25.84% revenue decline in FY26)
High finance costs (Rs 269.80 crore) and lease liabilities
Dependence on DTH license renewals from Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
facts.related_party_note: Not explicitly detailed in excerpts; references to investments/loans to subsidiaries (Note 9, 10, 37, 39) imply related party transactions.
